title: With Regret, I Close My Fake Review Farm
subtitle: Satire in favor of Lina Khan's Federal Trade Commission
text: The following article is satirical. Welcome to The Frontier Psychiatrists (TFPs) newsletter. It’s with great regret that I announce that my TFPs-Branded Fake Review Farm is closing. It’s been a good run. I had “a remarkable run,” according to fake reviews. We are so proud of our reviews—without an ounce of truth and with all the sheen. People talk…
